NBC sustaining crime/adventure series starring Frank Sinatra as odd-job worker Rocky Fortune. The historical run contains 25 numbered programs over 26 weeks; the frozen GRH container has 27 audio objects because programs 12 and 17 also survive as separate AFRTS rebroadcast objects.

GRH documents the program through 25-program NBC run (October 6, 1953 to March 30, 1954) on NBC Radio Network.
